business_updates: **Results season** — **16 companies filed** results or earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Hindustan Aeronautics** — signs the **final contract with SAFHAL**, its joint venture with Safran Helicopter Engines, to develop and produce the **Aravalli engine** in the 3,500–4,000 shp class for the Indian Multi-Role Helicopter and its naval variant; no value is stated.

**Nitco** — signs an **MoU with The House of Abhinandan Lodha** for a 40-acre mixed-use development at Alibaug, expected to generate about Rs 4,500 crore of revenue over five years, **of which Nitco's share is about Rs 1,500 crore**. Definitive agreements are not yet executed.
**Shoppers Stop** launches STOP × Peter England, a menswear collaboration, and **Jeena Sikho Lifecare** intimates a product launch.
capex_core: **Adani Energy Solutions** — wins the Satara pumped-storage evacuation scheme in Maharashtra through tariff-based competitive bidding at an **estimated capital expenditure of about Rs 4,700 crore**, adding 562 ckm of line and 9,000 MVA of transformation capacity over 36 months _(~2.5% of mcap)_.

**Park Medi World** — wins a PPP mandate from Prayagraj Municipal Corporation to build and run a **550-bed multi-super-speciality hospital for about Rs 200 crore** on a 45-year lease, with Rs 76.52 crore of the build reimbursed and an annual concession fee of Rs 18.10 crore _(~1.6% of mcap)_.

**Godrej Consumer Products** — inaugurates a **fourth Malanpur unit built for over Rs 480 crore**, taking cumulative investment at the site past Rs 850 crore and soap capacity beyond 2 lakh tonnes a year _(~0.5% of mcap)_.
**Samvardhana Motherson International** — commences commercial production at a subsidiary's new manufacturing facility.
**Deepak Nitrite** — subscribes, with Deepak Phenolics, to 95,00,000 9% preference shares of Deepak Chem Tech, its wholly owned subsidiary; an intra-group transfer that changes no external holding.
distress_risk: **Tata Steel** — the Supreme Court **allowed its appeal and quashed a Rs 890.52 crore GST input-credit demand and an equal Rs 890.52 crore penalty** for FY2018-19 to FY2020-21, setting aside the Jamshedpur order, with liberty to the department to re-initiate by 28 February 2027 _(~0.4% of mcap)_.
**Tata Steel** — separately, the Supreme Court issues notice returnable 5 October on Odisha's appeal against the High Court judgment that quashed two Sukinda mining demand letters.

**Innovision** — receives a GST show-cause notice proposing recovery of **Rs 10.70 crore** for FY2020-21 to FY2024-25 on exemptions claimed for user-fee toll collection; it notes an appellate order of 11 August decided a substantially similar matter in its favour.
**Max Healthcare Institute**, **G R Infraprojects** and **JSW Dulux** each disclose GST show-cause notices, while **Anik Industries** reports a penalty and **Mukta Arts** a show-cause notice.
**Reliance Communications** — discloses an order passed under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act.

**SKIL Infrastructure**, **Future Consumer**, **Owais Metal and Mineral Processing** and **DPSC** file insolvency housekeeping — committee-of-creditors meetings, an NCLT order, and the voting results of India Power Corporation's fourth CoC meeting.
**Bombay Burmah Trading**, **Punjab Chemicals & Crop Protection**, **Mahindra Holidays & Resorts** and **Tata Power** each disclose pending litigation.
equity_allotments: **MIC Electronics** — receives in-principle approval from both exchanges to issue equity shares on a preferential basis as consideration for acquiring NEO Semi SG Pte Ltd, Singapore (new; a stage below allotment).

**Kalana Ispat** — allots shares on the conversion of warrants issued earlier (a past conversion, not new capital); **Dhansa Labs** receives trading approval for shares issued on a similar conversion.
**United Heat Transfer** — files a revised board outcome and convenes an extraordinary general meeting; **Viji Finance** reports the outcome of its preferential allotment committee.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Anondita Medicare** — receives NSE in-principle approval for a proposed **rights issue of up to Rs 109.78 crore**; the issue price and ratio are still blank in the approval letter, a stage below allotment _(~5.7% of mcap)_.

**Ratnaveer Precision Engineering** — files the Letter of Offer for its **Rs 329.99 crore rights issue**, 1,24,99,669 shares at Rs 264 in a 7-for-40 ratio with a record date of 26 August, advancing the terms approved and published on 20 August.
**Ducon Infratechnologies** — submits the Letter of Offer for its rights issue of fully paid-up equity shares, alongside a corrigendum to its 19 August board outcome.
m_and_a: **SEPC** — its board grants in-principle approval for subsidiary SEPC FZE to acquire **100% of Wintality Petroleum FZE**, a UAE refined-products trader, **entirely through a share swap with no cash outflow**, leaving SEPC with 95.75% of the Sharjah arm. No consideration is stated.

**Time Technoplast** — grants in-principle approval to **merge TPL Plastech, its 74.86%-held listed subsidiary, into itself** with an appointed date of 1 April 2026; the swap ratio awaits a registered valuer, and the board separately decided **not to proceed** with the Ebullient Packaging acquisition after the MoU lapsed.
**Vikram Solar** — completes the acquisition of the entire shareholding of Vikram Solar Australia Pty Ltd, which becomes a wholly owned subsidiary.
**Bikaji Foods International** — sells a **30% stake in Bikaji Bakes** to Mr Thayekunni Khaleel; the unit ceases to be wholly owned and remains a 70% subsidiary.

**GP Petroleums** — signs a four-month **Exclusivity Agreement with Incubit DMCC** covering assets in India, the UAE, Mauritius and East Africa, for a **USD 100,000 fee** adjustable against the consideration; the filing states it is not a commitment to complete.

**IRB Infrastructure Developers** — files a Scheme of Amalgamation of certain wholly owned subsidiaries into itself, and separately approves subscribing **up to Rs 351 crore** to a preferential issue of IRB InvIT Fund units at Rs 65, funding the Trust's purchase of two project SPVs.

**Krishival Foods** — approves spending **up to Rs 35 crore of rights-issue proceeds**, partly by converting an existing loan, to lift its stake in subsidiary Melt 'N' Mellow Foods from 52.94% to 54.90% _(~4.0% of mcap)_.
**Nihar Info Global** — executes a definitive agreement with **MMTC-PAMP India** to add digital gold and silver to its GoldnSilver.shop platform, its third such provider after SafeGold and Augmont.

**Sapphire Foods India** files a Scheme of Arrangement, **Devyani International** strikes off a non-operational subsidiary, and **Chaman Metallics** reports an acquisition of equity shares by its promoter group.
order_wins: **GK Energy** — a Letter of Empanelment from a state government-owned discom for **1,00,000 grid-connected rooftop solar systems of 1 kW each, 100 MW in all, at Rs 45,450 per kW including GST, or about Rs 454.50 crore**, with five years of O&M _(~16.8% of mcap)_.

**Hazoor Multi Projects** — an **NHAI Letter of Award of Rs 193.85 crore** to act as user-fee agency for one year at the Paranur Fee Plaza on the Tambaram-Tindivanam section of NH-45 in Tamil Nadu _(~33.1% of mcap)_.

**Eleganz Interiors** — the contract from an unnamed leading IT company, first intimated on 11 September 2025, is modified and **the revised amount increased to approximately Rs 129.109 crore net** _(~57.2% of mcap)_.

**B.R.Goyal Infrastructure** — an **NHAI work order of Rs 119.85 crore** as user-fee agency for one year at the Surapattu Fee Plaza on the Chennai Bypass, Tamil Nadu, a different plaza from the Jajau award published on 22 August _(~27.2% of mcap)_.

**Chavda Infra** — a **Rs 54.72 crore order excluding GST** from Weisdom Design Build for the core and shell of a residential, commercial and five-star hotel building at Kudasan, Gandhinagar, over 24 months _(~12.0% of mcap)_.

**Ashwini Container Movers** — a five-year vessel-operations contract from an unnamed terminal operator at Jawaharlal Nehru Port, which the company expects to **generate about Rs 35 crore over the full five years** _(~12.6% of mcap)_.

**Ceigall India** — emerges as **L1 bidder** for the Lakadia–Jam Khambhaliya–Jamnagar Part-B inter-state transmission system, a 765/400 kV substation with 300 km of line; the award is still pending, and the Rs 608.67 crore stated is the annual transmission charge for each of 35 years.
**Siyaram Recycling Industries** — an order worth **Rs 3.19 crore** from Sahjanand Metal Alloys for brass scrap, to be executed within 30 days _(~4.0% of mcap)_.

**Relicab Cable Manufacturing** — a control-cable order of **Rs 2.26 crore including GST** from an international customer it identifies only as a leading global importer of wires and cables, for delivery by 31 October _(~6.2% of mcap)_.

**NIS Management** — a **Rs 1.50 crore work order** from West Bengal's Department of Technical Education, Training and Skill Development to train 210 rural youth and place 150 under DDU-GKY, over 36 months _(~1.5% of mcap)_.
**Bharat Electronics** — announces orders it puts at **Rs 730 crore** in the intimation's own title; the attachment we hold is unreadable, so nothing further is stated here _(~0.25% of mcap)_.
**Juniper Green Energy** — subsidiary Juniper Nirjara Energy executes a Power Purchase Agreement with SJVN for a **50 MW firm and dispatchable renewable energy project**; no contract value is stated.
**ACME Solar Holdings** — executes a Power Purchase Agreement, a day after taking 300 MW in SECI's assured peak power tender; no value is stated.
**Subex** — secures a **three-year HyperSense fraud-management engagement** with a leading African mobile operator, covering mobile-network and mobile-money fraud; the value is not disclosed.
**DMR Engineering** — a 12-month engineering-consultancy work order for a hydropower project in Lao PDR, worth **USD 200,000** (the filing states no rupee equivalent).
other_notable: **Man Infraconstruction** — its board will meet on 1 September to consider a **buyback of equity shares**, and **SIS** continues its open-market buyback.

**DCB Bank** — replying to a BSE query about a report that it is in talks with private-equity firms, says there is **no material event or information** requiring disclosure and that it cannot comment on the price move.

**Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences** — calls a report that it is in talks to buy a stake in Renova Hospitals for USD 52 million **“completely false, baseless and factually incorrect”**, saying no agreement, MoU or discussion exists.
**Quess Corp** replies to a query on a volume spurt, and **On Door Concepts** is asked by NSE to explain a price movement.
**Meenakshi India** — will consider a share sub-division on 31 August, and **Mold-Tek Packaging** amends its memorandum and articles.
